accent_note: The kernel has NO chromatic accent. The palette is pure achromatic: near-black ground, off-white band, a grey ramp. This is the single most distinctive thing about the identity and is treated as load-bearing, not as an omission to be filled.
motifs_inventoried: Scrolling ticker band: Bebas caps, 0.78rem, 0.3em tracking, #090909 on #F5F5F5, middot separators. Used once.
Zero-padded numerals 01-04 indexing list items. Used once.
Tiny wide-tracked uppercase eyebrow above every section heading: 10px, 0.3em tracking, #3A3A3A. Used consistently.
Grayscale-to-color image hover: brightness(.85) grayscale(.2) -> brightness(1) grayscale(0), 0.6s cubic-bezier(.25,.46,.45,.94).
Mosaic gallery where items 1 and 6 span double width.
Hard 0px corners on all containers; 999px pills reserved for pagination dots only.
Middot separator in kickers: 'Strength & Power', 'Recovery / Wellness', '1-on-1 / Strength'.

axes_shipped.color_stance: dark-dominant, one light moment at the primary action

divergence_check.color_stance_note: Changed from alternating high contrast to dark-dominant at client request. Still differs from the neighbour's duotone gold: this palette stays achromatic, and #F5F5F5 now appears exactly once, on the featured membership card.
divergence_check.shared_display_face: Bebas Neue is shared with the neighbour and CANNOT be changed — it is Fuel Fortress's own face, frozen by lock 2. Divergence is therefore carried entirely by the other axes, which differ on four of five.
